notes: Grammatically an action verb in Korean, so it is used in the past tense (못생겼어요, 'is ugly') as a predicate and takes -ㄴ (못생긴) before a noun.
The opposite of 잘생기다 (handsome). Mostly used for people; be careful, as calling someone 못생기다 directly is rude.
